status: REAL - enriched from live Open Targets + ClinicalTrials.gov + PubMed, 2026-07-11. HERO (genome-scale CD4 network nomination).
role_context: Genome-scale CD4+ T-cell CRISPRi (Gladstone/Marson) causal->PPI network nomination. IL2RB is NEVER a direct causal hit; it sits amid five causal hits (CD247/CD3zeta, STAT3, ITK, PTPRC/CD45, CD3D) with 1.7x diffusion enrichment from the TCR/cytokine-signalling seeds.
biology: Beta subunit shared by the IL-2 and IL-15 receptors (CD122). Transduces the mitogenic IL-2/IL-15 signal (JAK1/JAK3 -> STAT5) that governs CD4+ effector expansion, CD8+ cytotoxic/effector programs, Treg homeostasis and memory maintenance. gnomAD LoF-constrained. Human biallelic IL2RB loss-of-function causes an inborn error of immunity with immune dysregulation/autoimmunity.

tractability.assessment: pathway-validated, DRUG-ADJACENT (not a clean selective approved target)
tractability.interpretation: OT shows a structural ligand exists but NO druggable-family or clinical small molecule selective for IL2RB, Phase-1-level antibody tractability, and an approved drug only in the 'other clinical modality' bucket - i.e. the receptor is engaged by IL-2/IL-15 cytokine-agonist biologics, not by a selective IL2RB drug.

engaged_by_pathway_agonists.name: aldesleukin (recombinant IL-2, Proleukin)
engaged_by_pathway_agonists.note: Agonist of the IL-2 receptor complex (IL2RA/IL2RB/IL2RG); also in low-dose form for autoimmunity, e.g. type-1-diabetes trial ITAD NCT03782636 (Univ. Oxford, Phase 2). 554 IL-2/aldesleukin trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.

engaged_by_pathway_agonists.name: bempegaldesleukin (NKTR-214)
engaged_by_pathway_agonists.status: DISCONTINUED - 22 trials; the Nektar/BMS PIVOT + PROPEL programs were TERMINATED in 2022 after the pivotal Phase 3 melanoma readout failed (e.g. PROPEL-36 NCT04969861 terminated 2022).
engaged_by_pathway_agonists.note: Directly biases signalling through IL2RB/IL2RG over IL2RA - the clearest example of drugging the CD122 axis, but the program did not succeed.

engaged_by_pathway_agonists.name: AMG 714 (anti-IL-15)
engaged_by_pathway_agonists.note: Targets the IL-15 arm of the shared CD122 axis (vitiligo TRM biology); PMID 40791580.

known_drugs.CORRECTION_do_not_repeat: The approved anti-IL-2R antibodies BASILIXIMAB and DACLIZUMAB target IL2RA / CD25, NOT IL2RB. Daclizumab (Zinbryta) was WITHDRAWN from marketing in 2018 for safety (autoimmune hepatitis / encephalitis). Source: Perez-Miralles, Rev Neurol 2018 (PMID 29645071): 'Daclizumab is a monoclonal antibody directed against the CD25 subunit of the interleukin-2 receptor ... its withdrawn from marketing.' Any dossier that lists basiliximab/daclizumab as IL2RB drugs is WRONG.

genetic_evidence.score_caveat: Scores are OT OVERALL association (genetic + other datatypes aggregated), not a purely genetic score, and OT returns association strength, not signed direction. The theme is autoimmune / immune-dysregulation (immunodeficiency-with-autoimmunity, MS) plus IL-2-pathway oncology - consistent with a real CD4+ effector/Treg node.
genetic_evidence.direction: not signed by OT; mechanism = IL-2 signalling agonism enhances effector T cells, so pathway AGONISM is the IO/cell-therapy direction and DAMPENING is the autoimmune direction.

effector_biology_support: IL2RB/IL-2Rbeta is central to CD8+ tumour-infiltrating-lymphocyte expansion and IL-2 sensing; PGE2 impairs TIL expansion by downregulating IL2RG and disrupting IL2RB-IL2RG dimer assembly (Morotti et al., Nature 2024, PMID 38658764). Direct cell-therapy relevance for the effector axis this pipeline scores.
honest_caveats: IL2RB is a clinically PRECEDENTED pathway node, not a de-novo discovery. Its emergence validates that the causal->network->druggability pipeline recovers a real, actionable CD4+ T-cell node from raw Perturb-seq.

It is drug-ADJACENT: engaged by IL-2/IL-15 agonist biologics, with no selective approved IL2RB small molecule or antibody, and the flagship CD122-biased agonist (bempegaldesleukin) failed in the clinic.
The PPI network step used STRING v12 as a public substitute for the Gladstone-provided interaction network; IL2RB's diffusion enrichment (1.7x) is modest relative to VAV2/BLNK.
